title: AI Cybersecurity Threats: New Playbook Needed | WEF | World Economic Forum
text: ‘We're talking about new speed, we're talking about new scale, we are not necessarily talking about new problems.’As AI increases in power and scale, so do the opportunities for those who would use it as a weapon or tool for criminality. The global response to these threats is not yet up to speed, argues Kat Duffy, Senior Fellow for Digital and Cyberspace Policy at the Council On Foreign Relations. What’s needed is a new partnership between governments and the private sector - an international framework for cooperation, knowledge-sharing and enforcement. And as she explains here, the world already knows how to build it. The World Economic Forum’s Global Future Council for Cybersecurity convenes experts to improve cyber resilience practices across organizations and establish robust governance to safeguard our digital societies and economy.
